title: $LDL^\top$ Factorization-based Generalized Low-rank ADI Algorithm for Solving Large-scale Algebraic Riccati Equations
summary: The low-rank alternating direction implicit (ADI) method is an efficient and effective solver for large-scale standard continuous-time algebraic Riccati equations that admit low-rank solutions. However, the existing low-rank ADI algorithm for Riccati equations (RADI) cannot be directly applied to general-form Riccati equations. This paper introduces a generalized RADI algorithm based on an $LDL^\top$ factorization, which efficiently handles the general Riccati equations arising in important applications like state estimation and controller design. An efficient implementation is presented…
